assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The site boundary polygon in geometry/site_boundary.geojson is a provisional approximation derived from announcement text descriptions (北五环, 学院路, 西直门外大街, 大钟寺东路/荷清路) and the ~11.4 sqkm area value. It is not an official redline.
assumptions.impact: All area-based metrics (site_area_sqm, green_ratio, public_space_ratio, building_footprint_area_sqm) must be recalculated when the official boundary is released. Provisional boundary blocks formal professional scoring.

assumptions.statement: The three key area polygons in geometry/key_areas.geojson are provisional approximations placed along the provisional site boundary based on announcement sequence (北至南: 众智园, AI原点社区, 大钟寺) and announced area values (192.1 ha, 104.3 ha, 72.0 ha). Official polygons are not yet available.
assumptions.impact: Key area detailed designs, land use partitioning, and area calculations are provisional. Replacement with official polygons will require full redesign of geometry and metrics.

assumptions.statement: OpenStreetMap data may have been used as background reference for road network, building footprints, and land use patterns. OSM data is open-licensed (ODbL) but not authoritative for planning purposes.
assumptions.impact: OSM data is used only for design discussion and visualization; it is not used as official planning evidence. Attribution to OSM contributors is provided per ODbL requirements.

assumptions.statement: Official planning control data (FAR, building height limits, setback lines, road redlines, utility corridors, heritage protection zones) are not present in the public site package. The ranges/planning_limits.json file exists but contains only placeholder values.
assumptions.impact: All development intensity conclusions (density, height, floor area) are design proposals only. They must be treated as '待正式控规条件确认' (pending official regulatory confirmation) and cannot be cited as approved planning conditions.

assumptions.statement: All geometry features (buildings, land use, green space, public space, roads, phasing) are agent-generated design proposals with medium confidence. They are suitable for design discussion and visualization but not for precise engineering calculation.
assumptions.impact: Metric values derived from these geometries (building_footprint_area_sqm, green_ratio, public_space_ratio, road_length_m) carry the same precision warning. Official survey data will produce different values.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenario cards, user personas, landmark designs, and operational mechanisms described in the proposal are conceptual design proposals. They are written as '概念建议' (concept proposals) and '可供专业团队深化研究' (available for professional team deepening), not as confirmed government commitments.
assumptions.impact: Scenario implementation timelines, budget, and operational details must be developed by professional teams during subsequent design phases. No operational or financial commitments are implied.

assumptions.statement: The provisional site boundary area (11,412,825.386 sqm) is consistent with the official announcement value of approximately 11.4 sqkm (11,400,000 sqm) to within 0.11% deviation.
assumptions.impact: Area consistency is acceptable for design discussion. Official boundary replacement may produce a different area value.

assumptions.statement: Land use polygons in geometry/land_use.geojson are derived from site boundary partitioning and cover the full design area without gaps or overlaps, as verified by LAND_USE_TOPOLOGY self-check.
assumptions.impact: Land use topology passes self-check but remains provisional. Official land use classification, ownership, and zoning data will require redistribution of polygons.

assumptions.statement: The A3 booklet (drawings/a3-booklet.pdf) and A0 boards (drawings/a0-boards.pdf) are placeholder files. Replace with professionally rendered drawings before final submission.
assumptions.impact: Drawing-based evidence in compliance_matrix, standard_matrix, and design_depth_matrix references these files but the visual content is not yet populated.
